performance_question: Can one Envoy generic-with-callouts gateway reach a higher faithful Mooncake request rate when 24 pre-cached AIPerf clients are spread across nine available vCluster CPU nodes?
comparison_limit: This is a new nine-node load-generator series. Earlier two/three-node runs and the invalid AIPerf 0.13 single-manager attempt are contextual only; no cross-series percent gain or hard ceiling claim is authorized.
user_workload_note: Gateway-only mocker campaign outside the DGD recipe-optimization contract; this frozen plan and trace define the run.

trace.mmap_cache: Require HIT on all clients; no measured-phase tokenizer or composer work

instrument.version_selection: Reference-comparable client method with pre-synthesized mmap and the pinned reader-fix overlay; AIPerf 0.13 single-manager failed before measurement at 39 GB per-process memory and exit 137
instrument.aggregate_metric: Successful request count divided by one global interval from earliest per-request start to latest completion; reject if per-client replay degraded or profiling starts differ by over 3 seconds

placement.rationale: All nine currently schedulable vCluster-visible CPU-pool nodes; excludes one tainted/cordoned CPU node. This is a shared cluster, so capture occupancy and disqualify confounded runs.
placement.occupancy_policy: Record live competing pods before and after, without mutating unrelated namespaces.

evidence_limit: Mimics gateway throughput with synthetic workers and shared CPU nodes, not production-GPU performance. A valid observation at an offered load is not yet a hard ceiling.
